messages:
emily_cs: quick sweep — running a pilot adoption check for Cohort B. saw a dip in Week 1 attendance (29% -> 16%). can folks share latest enrollment confirmations and any enablement gaps? tagging opsbot for dashboard link.

raj_success: yup noticed that. i pulled the attendance heatmap this morning — looks like two timezones have repeated no-shows.

lin_eng: interesting — backend shows spikes in invite emails but click->signup funnel drops at the 'getting started' checklist. might be confusing.

olivia_se: i did 1:1s with 5 accounts yesterday. common theme: customers expect a short walkthrough video and a sample prompt pack. they keep asking for 'quick wins' before investing more time.

alan_sales: flagging a potential renewal risk for acct EC-219 — they said if adoption doesn't improve in 3 weeks they will pause. i put it on my radar.

emily_cs: ok action items: 1) opsbot — post latest cohort stats link here. 2) lin — can you surface which step in the checklist has the highest dropoff? 3) olivia — can you drop the 2-min walkthrough & prompt pack draft into the enablement folder by EOD tomorrow? 4) raj/alan — outreach owners for the two TZ clusters.

opsbot: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/pilot/cohortB · analytics snapshot generated 2026-03-23T08:07Z · CSV export: /exports/cohortB-metrics-6012345678.csv

lin_eng: quick check: dropoff highest at step 'connect api key' — many users hit a 403 during test call. digging into logs now.

olivia_se: copy — will draft walkthrough and prompt pack. planning to record a 90s video. will add captions.

raj_success: i'll take timezone cluster APAC -> Sarah and Dev outreach tonight. alan_sales — can you take EMEA cluster?

alan_sales: got it. i'll reach out to top 6 accounts and escalate EC-219.

emily_cs: thanks. let's reconvene Fri 14:00 PT. goal: +10pp attendance & 30% active usage by next check. if anyone needs extra hands on assets, ping here. :thumbsup:

olivia_se: tiny note — can we add a short in-app tooltip before the api-key step? could reduce dropoff.

lin_eng: agree — add tooltip + better 403 error copy. i'll put an emergency patch for the error message.

opsbot: reminder set: follow-up thread scheduled 2026-03-27T21:00Z (thread 6012345678-followup).
